name: Midi Fighter Twister (XT firmware, native mode)
description: For a Twister running the custom XT firmware (nativeMode build). The app switches the device into native mode while it runs: ring style follows the parameter (bar, bar with centre detent for bipolar, dot for endless and stepped), switch LEDs are true RGB, and there are no hardware banks: the bank-step button (right-top, shift + right-top: previous) walks the Perform pages. Knob turns are on ch1 (CC = knob), knob presses on ch2, side buttons on ch3 as CC 0-5 (left-top, left-middle, left-bottom, right-top, right-middle, right-bottom). Left-middle toggles Chain Link (shift: tap tempo), left-bottom is Shift, left-top, right-middle and right-bottom navigate as in the stock profile. Ring brightness is not available in native mode. The device returns to normal when the app quits; after a crash, replug it. No Utility settings file is needed.
